payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image retain photographic subject matter and appearance?
node.criteria: Pass if the subject matter remains recognizably photographic; fail if photographic subject matter or appearance is not retained; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to determine this.
node.binding: Assess the supplied image as edited for photographic subject matter and appearance alongside any stylistic changes.

response.content: {"status":"pass","evidence":"The edited image retains recognizable photographic subject matter and appearance: the street, buildings, vehicles, traffic light, and people remain depicted as a realistic photograph, despite slight tonal or stylistic changes.","confidence":0.97,"used_dependency_ids":[]}
